clue.text: Rope separator initially seen between fishes

indicators.note: the letter is placed between the two fish names

parts.note: two fish, the marlin and the pike, side by side

indicators.note: initially points to the opening letter of the word seen

explanation.surface: An angler spots something odd wedged between two fish on the slab.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fishes' supplies two fish at once, and 'between' sits the initial letter of 'seen' in the gap between them.
explanation.definitionFit: A pointed metal tool sailors use to prise apart the strands of rope when splicing.

clue.text: Distance marker moles tip up

indicators.note: up in the sense of stirred or disturbed, so the letters of moles tip are rearranged

explanation.surface: Burrowing moles overturn a roadside sign.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' is the anagram signal: the letters of MOLES TIP are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A post set beside a road showing the distance in miles to a place.

clue.text: Call Stewart about a by-pass

parts.note: to call someone on the phone is to ring them

indicators.note: the name is placed around the letter a

parts.note: Rod Stewart, the rock singer

explanation.surface: Phoning a singer to complain about a new bypass.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts A inside ROD, giving ROAD.
explanation.definitionFit: A road circling a town so traffic can avoid its centre, which is what a bypass does.

clue.text: European funfair is held inside

indicators.note: the letters sit inside the run of words funfair is held

explanation.surface: A European fair is being staged indoors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inside' shows the letters run inside funfaIR IS Held.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of Ireland, a European country.

clue.text: Dark Lord banishes you for following a flower

indicators.note: banishes says one letter is expelled from the name
for says another piece takes the expelled letter's place

parts.note: Sauron, the Dark Lord of Tolkien's The Lord of the Rings
U is text-speak for you
ff. is the abbreviation for following, as in following pages

explanation.surface: A villain casts someone out in pursuit of a flower.
explanation.walkthrough: 'banishes' and 'for' together signal a swap; ff. is the printed abbreviation for 'and following (pages)'. Sauron is the Dark Lord of Tolkien.
explanation.definitionFit: The saffron crocus is an autumn-blooming plant whose stigmas give the spice.

clue.text: Grannie's disturbed and could be shot

indicators.note: disturbed means upset or jumbled, so the letters of Grannie are rearranged

explanation.surface: An agitated grandmother fears she is a target.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disturbed' rearranges GRANNIE; the 's stands for 'is', a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Something within range is close enough for a gun to reach it.

clue.text: 9 team goes round copying others

indicators.note: goes round suggests the letters spinning into a new order

parts.note: the answer to 9 across, an Indian garment

explanation.surface: A sports team imitates rivals by running laps.
explanation.walkthrough: The bare '9' stands for the answer to 9 across; 'goes round' then churns it together with 'team'.
explanation.definitionFit: To emulate someone is to imitate them in the hope of matching them.

clue.text: Fun cut short

indicators.note: short means the word loses its final letter

parts.note: a gash is a deep cut

explanation.surface: An enjoyable time is brought to a premature end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short' drops the last letter of GASH. A 'gas' is informal for great fun.
explanation.definitionFit: Informally, something that is a real gas is a great laugh or lark.

clue.text: Works hard to get good service at empty tearooms

parts.note: the RAF, Britain's Royal Air Force, is one of the armed services

indicators.note: empty leaves only the outer letters of tearooms

explanation.surface: A waitress toils to give good service in deserted cafes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'empty' leaves TS, the outer letters of 'tearooms'.
explanation.definitionFit: Graft is informal British for hard work, so someone who grafts toils away.

clue.text: Smell first of some fish

indicators.note: first of picks the opening letter of the word some

parts.note: the tench is a freshwater fish

explanation.surface: A whiff coming off the first fish you catch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first of' takes S from 'some'.
explanation.definitionFit: A stench is a strong, foul odour.

clue.text: Actress Cherie wastes hours getting Indian dress

indicators.note: wastes means she throws away a letter from her surname

parts.note: Cherie Lunghi, the British actress

explanation.surface: An actress squanders time before getting into Indian costume.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wastes' takes H (hours) out of LUNGHI.
explanation.definitionFit: A lungi is a sarong-like cloth wrapped around the waist, worn in India.

clue.text: Lucky because fish finishes in last place

parts.note: for can mean because, as in 'for he was tired'
tuna is a fish

indicators.note: finishes in takes the final letters of the words last and place

explanation.surface: Coming in last still counts as lucky for a fish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'finishes in' takes T and E, the ends of 'last place'.
explanation.definitionFit: Fortunate is a straightforward synonym for having good luck.

clue.text: Fish extremely eager to be riding horse

parts.note: the perch is a freshwater fish

indicators.note: extremely takes the extreme letters of the word eager

parts.note: on, as when one is on a horse

explanation.surface: A fish keen to ride a horse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'extremely' takes ER, the outer letters of 'eager'.
explanation.definitionFit: The Percheron is a heavy French breed of draught horse.

clue.text: American, one Cortez destroyed after stealing gold

parts.note: a means one, as in 'a dog'

indicators.note: destroyed means the remaining letters are smashed into a new order
after stealing describes the name once its gold is taken away

parts.note: or is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: Cortez wiped out a native people after taking their gold.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after stealing' leaves CTEZ once the gold is gone, and 'destroyed' scrambles those four letters. Gold as or comes from heraldry.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of the Mexican people, natives of the Americas, whose empire Cortez conquered.

clue.text: Itinerant Australian's bird carrying silver money

indicators.note: carrying means the bird holds the other letters inside it

parts.note: a swan is a bird
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: An Australian's pet bird has been ferrying silver coins.
explanation.walkthrough: 'carrying' signals the insertion; the 's after the definition is short for 'is', a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A swagman tramps the Australian outback carrying his bundle of belongings, or swag.

clue.text: Detectives all over problem raised by low ambient sounds

parts.note: to low is to moo like a cow

indicators.note: raised turns the combination upwards, reading it backwards in a down entry
all over says the detectives surround the problem

parts.note: CID, the Criminal Investigation Department of British police
a sum is an arithmetic problem

explanation.surface: Detectives brood over a puzzle while soft background noise plays.
explanation.walkthrough: 'all over' makes CISUMD, and 'raised' flips it to DMUSIC, since in a down entry raising reads upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Mood music is soft background music meant to create an atmosphere.

clue.text: European Commission accepts irrational tale of heroism

indicators.note: accepts means the commission takes in the other letters

parts.note: pi is an irrational number

explanation.surface: Brussels takes on board a wild story of bravery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'irrational' looks like a description of the tale, but it stands for pi, the irrational number; 'accepts' signals the insertion.
explanation.definitionFit: An epic is a long narrative of heroic deeds.

clue.text: Laxative infusion for Spooner's state

indicators.note: Spooner's says the opening sounds of the state's parts are swapped

parts.note: Tennessee is a US state; its opening sounds are ten-na
the closing sound of the US state Tennessee is see

explanation.surface: A laxative drink recommended for a state.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spooner's' swaps the T and S sounds of TEN-NA-SEE to give SEN-NA-TEA.
explanation.definitionFit: Senna leaves brewed in hot water make a traditional laxative drink.

clue.text: Hoodwink fish with ultimately bogus comforts

parts.note: to con is to deceive
the sole is a flatfish

indicators.note: ultimately takes the final letter of bogus

explanation.surface: Fooling a fish with fake reassurance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ultimately' takes S, the last letter of 'bogus'.
explanation.definitionFit: To console is to soothe someone in distress.

clue.text: Fish with a tailpiece

parts.note: cod is a fish

explanation.surface: A fish served with a tail.
explanation.definitionFit: In music a coda is the closing section that rounds off a piece.

clue.text: Warlike, regularly starts to mount attacks against random Dutch city

indicators.note: regularly takes every other letter of Warlike
starts to takes the first letters of the four following words

explanation.surface: Warlike invaders launch random raids on a Dutch city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' takes A, L, K from 'Warlike'; 'starts to' takes MAAR.
explanation.definitionFit: Alkmaar is a city in North Holland, famous for its cheese market.

clue.text: Upset, although not cross, X-Men go at their foe

indicators.note: upset means the remaining letters are knocked into another order
not means the cross is left out

parts.note: a cross is the letter X

explanation.surface: Though calm, the X-Men go after their arch-enemy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not' removes X (cross) from X-MEN GO AT; 'Upset' rearranges MENGOAT.
explanation.definitionFit: Magneto, the master of magnetism, is the chief villain fighting the X-Men in Marvel comics.

clue.text: Fellow of the French Nelson?

parts.note: a fellow is a man
de la is French for 'of the'

explanation.surface: Asking whether an English admiral was French.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nelson' suggests the admiral; the question mark points to Nelson Mandela instead.
explanation.definitionFit: Nelson is the first name of Mandela, South Africa's first black president.

clue.text: A mother I see naked

parts.note: a dam is an animal's mother
C sounds like see; in crosswords see can also give C as the letter name

explanation.surface: A mother spots something unclothed.
explanation.definitionFit: Adamic means like Adam, who lived unclothed in Eden before the Fall.

clue.text: Fishes in corners

definitions.meaning: goes fishing with rod and line
points where two lines or walls meet

explanation.surface: Fish swimming into the corners.
explanation.definitionFit: To angle is to fish with a hook, and angles are also the corners formed by meeting lines.

clue.text: Hidden images showing tough stuff

indicators.note: showing means the letters are on display within Hidden images

explanation.surface: Secret photos revealing something rugged.
explanation.walkthrough: 'showing' reveals the letters in hidDEN IMages.
explanation.definitionFit: Denim is the hard-wearing cotton twill used for jeans.

clue.text: Fish included in types of firelighters

indicators.note: included in means the fish goes inside the word for types

parts.note: kinds are types
the ling is a fish of the cod family

explanation.surface: A fish counts among various kinds of firelighter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'included in' signals the insertion; ling is a long, cod-like sea fish.
explanation.definitionFit: Kindling is the small sticks used to get a fire going.

clue.text: Large archipelago, large plant

parts.note: Arch. is the abbreviation for archipelago

explanation.surface: A list of big islands and big plants.
explanation.definitionFit: The larch is a tall deciduous conifer, a tree.

clue.text: Exploits fish drink

parts.note: to milk something is to exploit it
hake is a fish

explanation.surface: Someone takes advantage of a fishy drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A cold drink of milk blended with flavouring or ice cream.

clue.text: Honey-badger gets speed on line

parts.note: a rate is a speed

explanation.surface: A honey badger picks up its pace in a straight line.
explanation.definitionFit: The ratel is an African and Asian carnivore, the honey badger.

clue.text: Chefs miss out on good lettuce

indicators.note: miss out on means the cooks lose the letters for good

parts.note: cooks are chefs
OK means good

explanation.surface: Cooks fail to get decent lettuce.
explanation.walkthrough: 'miss out on' takes OK (good) out of COOKS.
explanation.definitionFit: Cos is a variety of lettuce with long crisp leaves, also called romaine.

clue.text: Fish in a hat's ridiculous for mountains

parts.note: carp is a fish

indicators.note: ridiculous means the letters of in a hat's are rearranged absurdly

explanation.surface: A fish wearing a hat looks absurd in the mountains.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ridiculous' rearranges IN A HATS to give ATHIANS.
explanation.definitionFit: The Carpathians are a mountain range of central and eastern Europe.
